verdict.rationale: The only capture evidence is the pricing page's claim that you can save content from WhatsApp, Telegram, Twitter, or via email, plus a mention of mobile capture on the go. Emailing or forwarding a link is an indirect workaround, not a browser clipping flow. Missing for 10: an official browser extension or web clipper, saving full web pages or articles, capturing highlights from the browser, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of any web-capture flow.
